# Digital Apprenticeship Platform - SkillBridge

## 🎯 Complete Production-Ready Platform

A comprehensive web application that bridges academic learning and real-world industry skills.

### ✨ Key Highlights

- **Full-Stack:** React + Express + MongoDB
- **Production-Ready:** Security, validation, error handling
- **Role-Based:** 5 user roles with different permissions
- **Scalable:** Docker support, API design ready for growth
- **Well-Documented:** 6 documentation files
- **Sample Data:** 20+ records ready to explore
- **Modern UI:** Responsive, animated, user-friendly

## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
# Backend
cd server && npm install && npm run seed && npm run dev

# Frontend (new terminal)
cd client && npm install && npm start
```

**Login:** rahul@example.com / password123

## 🎨 Features

### Students
- Real-world task submissions
- XP, badges, skill tracking
- Progress visualization
- Internship matching

### Companies
- Post industry tasks
- Review submissions
- Shortlist candidates
- Rate student work

### Educators
- Assign tasks
- Monitor progress
- Download reports
- Collaborate

### Admin
- User management
- Task approval
- Analytics
- System control

## 🛠 Tech Stack

- **Frontend:** React 18, Tailwind CSS, React Router, Axios
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, bcryptjs
- **DevOps:** Docker, Docker Compose

## 📊 API Endpoints (20+)

- Authentication: Register, Login, Get Current User
- Users: Get Profile, Update, List, Delete
- Tasks: Create, Read, Update, Delete, Filter, Submit
- Plus: Companies, Educators, Admin, Analytics

## 🔐 Security

- JWT authentication
- Password hashing (bcrypt)
- Role-based access
- Input validation
- CORS configured

## 🐳 Docker Support

```bash
docker-compose build
docker-compose up
```

Runs on http://localhost:3000 and http://localhost:5000

## 📈 Database

6 Collections with 20+ sample records:
- Users (3 students, 2 companies, 1 educator)
- Tasks (8 sample projects)
- Submissions, StudentProfile, Company, Internship
